_drafted_note: Drafted 2026-08-23 from the world's OWN archipelago.json, README and releases. No field is filled in from memory or from what other games on the same platform do.
_platform_source: the project ships its own Windows client
description: The fan revival of Toontown Online as a multiworld, solo or with others.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game -- no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until somebody has played it through London. Built is not tested.
_requires_source: the fan client is a free download from the project itself -- nobody sells this game. Recorded as "free"; "download" is not a value the build accepts, and an invented one is rejected rather than guessed at.
_mod_kind_source: a fan revival of Disney's Toontown Online, which closed in 2013. Built by the Toontown Archipelago project on the Open Toontown codebase.

client.name: Toontown
client._kind_source: the project ships the whole game and its own Archipelago client
client._protocol_source: the world opens its own connection to the game -- no emulator memory protocol is involved, so London carries nothing but the launch. Recorded as "self" rather than naming a bridge we do not use.

apworld._source: the repository named as repo_url in the world's own archipelago.json; latest v0.19.7 carries toontown.apworld

_install_kind_source: the apworld plus the project's own game client, which the player downloads
setup: Download toontown.apworld and the game client from the release.
Put toontown.apworld in Archipelago's custom_worlds folder.
Run the project's client and connect it to the room.

patch._source: the setup guide describes no patching step

_patch_extension_source: world source not downloaded -- repo policy is addresses only. Flagged in every build until somebody reads it.

world_by.name: Toontown Archipelago
world_by._source: the repository that publishes this world, read 2026-08-23
world_by._licence_source: read from the repository's LICENSE file 2026-08-23: "The following license applies to all files, excluding ones found in the folder named resources. Copyright 2022 Toontown Open-Source Initiative". A project-specific licence, not a standard one, which is why GitHub classifies it as NOASSERTION.
world_by._authors_source: the organisation that publishes the repository. Its README credits Open Toontown for the Python 3 codebase and Project Bikehorn (toonjoey) for textures.

credits.game_by: originally Disney (Toontown Online, closed 2013); this revival is fan-built
credits._note: Toontown Online was Disney's and closed in 2013. This is a fan revival, distributed by its own project and never by us. Only the plugin itself is by solida1987.

_warning: The world's own README states that Toontown AS A WHOLE is a banned topic in official Archipelago spaces. That is their community's rule, not a legal or technical problem, and nobody has asked us to remove this game -- but do not take questions about it to the Archipelago Discord.
